(Sec. 2001) This section reauthorizes the United States Grain Standards Act, which authorizes the Department of Agriculture to establish official marketing standards for grains.

Specifically, this section extends the authority of the Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS) through December 11, 2026, to (1) collect fees for required federal supervision of official inspections and…
(Sec. 2002) This section extends the authority for the Forest Service to use the Agriculture Conservation Experienced Services (ACES) program through December 11, 2026.

…and administrative services for conservation-related programs that are executed on or directly impacting National Forest System land.
(Sec. 2005) This section extends through December 11, 2026, the authority of the Environmental Protection Agency to collect user fees under the Toxic Substances Control Act.
(Sec. 2006) This section increases Medicaid funding for FY2026 for the Northern Mariana Islands.
(Sec. 2007) This section reduces funding for the Medicare Improvement Fund beginning in FY2027.
(Sec. 2008) This section extends through December 31, 2028, trade preferences that provide duty-free access to the U.S. market for most exports from eligible countries in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA).

Specifically, the section extends through 2028 the duty-free treatment of the products of beneficiary SSA countries under the Trade Act of 1974 (specifically, the Generalized System of Preferences) and the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).

Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
Z000018.note: OpenFEC returned no itemized individual contributions by employer for this committee in the 2026 cycle. The most recent completed cycle (2024) was also checked: no itemized employer rows were returned. Cycles are never combined.
